Examples: [Fix] attention: Fix KV cache indexing; [Perf] [AMD] flash-attn: Optimize decode performance. -->

## Motivation

Out-of-range BF16/FP16 KV values can become NaN when cast directly
  to float8_e4m3fn. This affects the MHA write path and both the combined
  and split MLA write paths.

  Clamp values to the representable FP8 range before casting to prevent
  overflow from introducing NaNs into the KV cache.

## Modifications

  - Apply saturate_to_fp8_range before the existing FP8 casts in
    MHATokenToKVPool.set_kv_buffer.
  - Apply the same handling to MLATokenToKVPool.set_kv_buffer and
    the split NoPE/RoPE write path.
  - Add three CUDA regression tests covering these write paths.
  - Register the tests in base-b with the 1-gpu-small runner.


## Accuracy Tests

Local numerical regression tests on NVIDIA H800:

  - Fixed code: all 3 tests passed.
  - Pre-fix code: all 3 tests failed numerical assertions due to NaNs.
  - Tests check positive and negative overflow and representable values.

  Validation used PyTorch 2.9.1+cu128, which differs from the repository
  pin. Transformers 5.19.0, tokenizers 0.23.2, and compressed-tensors
  0.18.0 matched repository pins. No runtime compatibility patches
  were used.

  Model-level accuracy evaluation has not been run.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Not run. The change adds clamp operations to the affected FP8 write
  paths; their impact on end-to-end inference performance has not
  been measured.

## Checklist

- [ ] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [ ✔️] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [ ] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [ ] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

## Review and Merge Process

1. Ping Merge Oncalls to start the process. See the [PR Merge Process](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/MAINTAINER.md#pull-request-merge-process).
2. Get approvals from [CODEOWNERS](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/CODEOWNERS) and other reviewers.
3. Trigger CI tests with [comments](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#how-to-trigger-ci-tests) or contact authorized users to do so.
   - Common commands include `/tag-and-rerun-ci`, `/tag-run-ci-label`, `/rerun-failed-ci`
4. After green CI and required approvals, ask Merge Oncalls or people with Write permission to merge the PR.

files.patch:
@@ -2910,6 +2910,9 @@ def set_kv_buffer(
                 cache_k.div_(k_scale)
             if v_scale is not None:
                 cache_v.div_(v_scale)
+            if self.dtype == fp8_dtype:
+                cache_k = saturate_to_fp8_range(cache_k, self.dtype)
+                cache_v = saturate_to_fp8_range(cache_v, self.dtype)
             cache_k = cache_k.to(self.dtype)
             cache_v = cache_v.to(self.dtype)
 
@@ -4862,6 +4865,8 @@ def set_kv_buffer(
             "declared which loc space it emits."
         )
         if cache_k.dtype != self.dtype:
+            if self.dtype == fp8_dtype:
+                cache_k = saturate_to_fp8_range(cache_k, self.dtype)
             cache_k = cache_k.to(self.dtype)
 
         if self.store_dtype != self.dtype:
@@ -4909,8 +4914,12 @@ def _write_mla_kv_buffer(
             self._scatter_mla_rows(dst_buffer, loc, cache_k_nope_fp8, cache_k_rope_fp8)
         else:
             if cache_k_nope.dtype != self.dtype:
+                if self.dtype == fp8_dtype:
+                    cache_k_nope = saturate_to_fp8_range(cache_k_nope, self.dtype)
                 cache_k_nope = cache_k_nope.to(self.dtype)
                 if cache_k_rope is not None and cache_k_rope.numel() > 0:
+                    if self.dtype == fp8_dtype:
+                        cache_k_rope = saturate_to_fp8_range(cache_k_rope, self.dtype)
                     cache_k_rope = cache_k_rope.to(self.dtype)
             if self.store_dtype != self.dtype:
                 cache_k_nope = cache_k_nope.view(self.store_dtype)

@@ -0,0 +1,104 @@
+"""Overflowing KV values must remain finite after conversion to FP8 storage."""
+
+import unittest
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+
+import torch
+
+from sglang.srt.mem_cache.memory_pool import MHATokenToKVPool, MLATokenToKVPool
+from sglang.srt.runtime_context import get_parallel
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cuda_ci
+from sglang.test.test_utils import CustomTestCase
+
+register_cuda_ci(est_time=10, stage="base-b", runner_config="1-gpu-small")
+
+
+class TestFP8KVCacheSaturation(CustomTestCase):
+    def setUp(self):
+        super().setUp()
+        self.enterContext(
+            get_parallel().override(dcp_enabled=False, attn_dcp_size=1, attn_dcp_rank=0)
+        )
+        # Slot zero is reserved for CUDA-graph padding.
+        self.loc = torch.tensor([1], dtype=torch.int64, device="cuda")
+
+    def test_overflowing_kv_values_saturate_instead_of_nan(self):
+        pool = MHATokenToKVPool(
+            size=1,
+            page_size=1,
+            dtype=torch.float8_e4m3fn,
+            head_num=1,
+            head_dim=4,
+            layer_num=1,
+            device="cuda",
+            enable_memory_saver=False,
+        )
+        cache_k = torch.tensor(
+            [[[688.0, -700.0, 448.0, 1.0]]], dtype=torch.bfloat16, device="cuda"
+        )
+        cache_v = torch.tensor(
+            [[[-449.0, 573.0, -448.0, 2.0]]], dtype=torch.bfloat16, device="cuda"
+        )
+        layer = SimpleNamespace(layer_id=0)
+
+        pool.set_kv_buffer(
+            layer,
+            self.loc,
+            cache_k,
+            cache_v,
+        )
+
+        expected_k = torch.tensor(
+            [[[448.0, -448.0, 448.0, 1.0]]], dtype=torch.float32, device="cuda"
+        )
+        expected_v = torch.tensor(
+            [[[-448.0, 448.0, -448.0, 2.0]]], dtype=torch.float32, device="cuda"
+        )
+        torch.testing.assert_close(pool.get_key_buffer(0)[1].float(), expected_k[0])
+        torch.testing.assert_close(pool.get_value_buffer(0)[1].float(), expected_v[0])
+
+    def test_overflowing_mla_combined_values_saturate_instead_of_nan(self):
+        self._check_mla_saturation(split=False)
+
+    def test_overflowing_mla_split_values_saturate_instead_of_nan(self):
+        self._check_mla_saturation(split=True)
+
+    def _check_mla_saturation(self, split):
+        pool = MLATokenToKVPool(
+            size=1,
+            page_size=1,
+            dtype=torch.float8_e4m3fn,
+            kv_lora_rank=4,
+            qk_rope_head_dim=2,
+            layer_num=1,
+            device="cuda",
+            enable_memory_saver=False,
+        )
+        cache_k_nope = torch.tensor(
+            [[[688.0, -700.0, 448.0, -449.0]]],
+            dtype=torch.bfloat16,
+            device="cuda",
+        )
+        cache_k_rope = torch.tensor(
+            [[[573.0, -448.0]]],
+            dtype=torch.bfloat16,
+            device="cuda",
+        )
+        layer = SimpleNamespace(layer_id=0)
+
+        if split:
+            pool.set_mla_kv_buffer(layer, self.loc, cache_k_nope, cache_k_rope)
+        else:
+            cache_k = torch.cat((cache_k_nope, cache_k_rope), dim=-1)
+            pool.set_kv_buffer(layer, self.loc, cache_k, cache_k)
+
+        expected_k = torch.tensor(
+            [[[448.0, -448.0, 448.0, -448.0, 448.0, -448.0]]],
+            dtype=torch.float32,
+            device="cuda",
+        )
+        torch.testing.assert_close(pool.get_key_buffer(0)[1].float(), expected_k[0])
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()
